user.title: Connect to Companies House
user.description: Paste the API key from your Companies House developer hub application ({developer_hub}). Each key may make 600 requests every 5 minutes. This integration uses a small fraction of that.

data_description.api_key: A REST API key for an application registered on the Companies House developer hub.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Companies House
reauth_confirm.description: Companies House rejected your saved API key. Paste a new one. Everything you are watching carries on where it left off.

data_description.api_key: A REST API key for an application registered on the Companies House developer hub.

reconfigure.title: Replace the API key
reconfigure.description: Paste a new key. Everything you are watching is kept.

data_description.api_key: A REST API key for an application registered on the Companies House developer hub.

abort.already_configured: That API key is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new key works. Monitoring has resumed.

error.invalid_auth: Companies House rejected that key. Check you copied all of it, and that it is a live REST key, not a test one.
error.rate_limited: Companies House is asking this key to slow down. Try again in a few minutes.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Companies House. Check your connection and try again.

init.title: Companies House options
init.description: Companies House allows 600 requests every 5 minutes. With these settings, checks will use about {projected} of them. You cannot save settings that would need more than {limit}.

data.due_soon_days: Warn this many days before a deadline
data.max_pages: Pages to fetch for very long lists

data_description.due_soon_days: The "due soon" warnings switch on this many days before a deadline.
data_description.document_directory: Where downloaded documents are saved. Each company gets its own folder.
data_description.max_pages: Only matters for companies with hundreds of officers, owners or charges. Each page holds 100. 10 is plenty for almost everyone.
data_description.cadence_multiplier: 1 is normal. 2 checks half as often. 3 checks a third as often.

error.budget_exceeded: These settings would check more often than Companies House allows. Slow things down, or take some companies off close watch.

user.title: Find a company
user.description: Type part of the company name. Or enter a postcode to find the company registered at an address.

data_description.query: Part of the company name is enough. A company number, or the address of the company's page on the Companies House website, goes straight to it.
data_description.postcode: Optional. Only show companies registered at this postcode.

confirm.title: Watch {company}
confirm.description: Company number {number}. Choose what to keep an eye on.

data_description.datasets: The company's details and filings are always watched. Untick anything else you do not need.
data_description.close_watch: Check this company every 15 minutes during office hours. Normally checks slow down when nothing is due. Turn this on if you need to hear about changes fast.
data_description.notify_instantly: Raise an alert the moment anything changes, so an automation can push it to your phone or email.
data_description.in_weekly_report: Include this company in the report built by the digest action.
data_description.label: Optional. Shown next to the company name, for example "Our landlord" or "Contractor, 47 High Street".
data_description.website: Optional, for example example.co.uk. Used for the company's logo and a link in reports.

menu_options.track_officer: Follow one of this company's officers

data_description.datasets: The company's details and filings are always watched. Untick anything else you do not need.

track_officer.title: Follow an officer of {company}
track_officer.description: Pick a current officer. You will then see every company they are involved with, not just this one.

error.no_results: Nothing matched. Try a different name or postcode.

abort.officer_already_configured: You are already following that person.

user.title: Find a person
user.description: Search by name for a director, secretary or other officer. Many people share a name. Use the month and year of birth in the results to pick the right one.

data_description.query: You can also paste the address of the person's page on the Companies House website.

data_description.watch_companies: Add every company they currently hold a role at, and any they join later, as watched companies.

menu_options.add_record: Add another register record for this person

data_description.officer_name: Useful when the register holds more than one record for the same person.
data_description.watch_companies: Add every company they currently hold a role at, and any they join later, as watched companies.
data_description.notify_instantly: Raise an alert the moment this person takes or leaves a role, so an automation can push it to your phone or email.
data_description.in_weekly_report: Include this person in the report built by the digest action.

add_record.title: Find another record
add_record.description: The register opens a new record whenever someone is appointed with slightly different details. Search for the person again, or paste the address of the other record's page.

pick_record.title: Choose the record to add to {name}
pick_record.description: Its appointments will be pooled with the ones already followed.

rate_limited.title: Companies House is asking us to slow down

confirm.title: Slow the checks down?
confirm.description: Companies House has refused requests for over 15 minutes. Either something else is using your API key, or too many companies are on close watch. Confirm to check less often. You can change this back later in the options.

confirm.title: Stop watching {company}?
confirm.description: {company} ({number}) has been dissolved or removed from the register. From now on it is only checked once a month. Confirm to stop watching it and remove it from Home Assistant. Or ignore this notice to keep its history.

company_not_found.title: Company {number} is no longer on the register

confirm.title: Stop watching company {number}?
confirm.description: Companies House has no record of company {number} any more. Confirm to stop watching it and remove it from Home Assistant.

officer_not_found.title: {name} is no longer on the register

confirm.title: Stop following {name}?
confirm.description: Companies House has no record of {name} (reference {officer_id}) any more. Confirm to stop following them and remove them from Home Assistant.
